cohort: The study included 48 pregnant patients, comprising 12 SjD patients matched 1:3 with 36 non-SjD controls, with exclusions for concurrent autoimmune disease or related antibodies.
finding: There was an increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcome (APO) in SjD patients compared with controls, although no significant difference in neonatal outcomes was found.
mod_finding: SjD patients were more likely to be delivered by cesarean delivery.
